the results of the empirical study confirm the context and type of service dependency.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
bank employees have different attitudes and behaviors depending on the perspective from which they view the service.
e-service quality is context-dependent, service-type dependent and dependent on perspective.
the internal and external perspectives are different and the impact of the factors on satisfaction and loyalty is also different, depending on the perspective of the bank employee.
The main takeaway from our work is that
people's perspectives are important and that context dependency is important.
e-service providers should not only consider the external customer perspective when developing and improving their e-services, but also the internal perspective.
e-service providers should be aware that their employees' perspective on e-services is different from that of their customers.
